events.title: SYSTEM BOOT
events.description: Emergency firmware loaded. Life support: NOMINAL. Hull integrity: DEGRADED. Crew status: UNKNOWN. Awaiting command.

choices.log: Recovery protocol initiated. Oxygen scrubbers online.

events.title: O2 CRITICAL
events.description: Oxygen reserves below 20%. Crew consciousness compromised. Emergency options available.

choices.log: Power rerouted. Oxygen scrubbers at 140% capacity.
Emergency tank vented. Hull stress detected.

events.title: ANOMALOUS SIGNAL
events.description: Unknown transmission on emergency freq 121.5 MHz. Signal strength: STRONG. Origin: UNRESOLVED. Respond?

choices.log: ID burst transmitted on 121.5. Awaiting reply...

events.title: RESPONSE RECEIVED
events.description: 'SECTOR 7 CLEAR. RENDEZVOUS COORD FOLLOW. AUTHENTICATE WITH REGISTRY CODE.' Registry code on file. Transmit?

choices.log: Auth accepted. Rendezvous coordinates received and stored.

events.title: REACTOR OVERLOAD
events.description: Reactor output exceeds nominal by 40%. Capacitors near saturation. Action required.

events.title: HULL BREACH IMMINENT
events.description: Microfracture network expanding in Sections 3–4. Estimated 8 hours until structural failure. Options?

choices.log: EVA team reports breach sealed. O2 consumption high.

events.title: INTELLIGENCE FRAGMENT
events.description: Data scan complete. Fragment recovered: pre-incident crew manifest. Decrypt?

choices.log: Decryption complete. 12 crew members listed as present at incident.

events.title: CREW STATUS
events.description: Manifest analysis: 3 survivors in cryo-stasis detected. Stasis pods consuming backup power. Sustain?

choices.log: Stasis pods online. Three lives maintained at cost of 20 energy.
Revival initiated. Survivors conscious. Hull repair assistance available.
